description: The distinguishing feature of immigration limbo is the absence of a date. Plans cannot be made and grief cannot be finished.
Children, property, career moves and elderly-parent care are all postponed pending a decision that does not come.
Counselling is often outside basic coverage for temporary residents.

aspect: EXAMPLE - lives held open for a decade
description: Students in the Vice report described putting personal and professional lives on hold for up to ten years - missing job opportunities, conferences and family weddings, not because of a refusal but because no answer ever came.

aspect: SCENARIO - the decisions he stopped making
description: By month 20 Omid has stopped buying furniture, stopped going to the dentist and stopped replying to a woman he liked, because he cannot answer the question 'where will you be next year'. He is not depressed and he is not fine. There is no word for it and no box for it on any form.
energy_note: A life on hold is not a life, and does not count as a harm.

description: The bandwidth research is the measured version of what HLT-001 describes qualitatively: uncertainty is not merely unpleasant, it consumes the cognitive capacity that planning and problem-solving run on, by about a standard deviation.
